# App Tools Protocol (ATP), vendored

Do not edit these files. They are the ATP drop `atp-v0.23` (amcp commit `e6d131fb55bceb1ed0afe0f0b865afda015ee636`), spec version 0.1,
under the Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`, attribution in `NOTICE`). To update them, run `tools/export-drop.ps1 -Tag <tag> -Dest <this folder>`
in the amcp repository. `SHA256SUMS` lists every file, and this repository's checksum test fails on any edit.

`wire/build.gradle.kts` and `provider/build.gradle.kts` belong to this repository and are not part of the drop.
